[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:387YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Announced by Ada Droon, Mistress of Monuments">I announce the construction of a memorial in Bulgakov to commemorate those Varushkan citizens who were killed in the attacks by the Cold Sun, and those brave knights-errant who gave their lives against the scions to allow many citizens of the vale to escape. The monument will be designed by Triska Markova of the Druzhba Karova. Bulgakov; Duzekani; Karov
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs an [[edifice]] in Duzekani, [[Karov]]
* Announcement by the [[Mistress of Monuments]]

==Date==
* Autumn 387YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 4 wains of weirwood
* 1 wain of white granite
* 15 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Bulgakov_Memorial}}
==Outcome==
Now complete, the warding stakes stand around Bulgakov, in [[Karov#Duzekani|Duzekani]], Karov
